issues.body: `_execute_age_unpark_actions` now returns six values `(outcome, grants, convergences, stalls, standing, unreachable)`, and its docstring and caller reflect that, but its signature remains `tuple[PhaseOutcome, int, int, int]`. This makes the public type contract inaccurate and can produce false static-analysis errors for the updated six-value unpacking.
issues.fix_hint: Update the return annotation to `tuple[PhaseOutcome, int, int, int, int, int]` (or introduce a named result type if preferred).
issues.title: Return annotation still describes the old four-element tuple

verdict.summary: The change is sound and fail-closed: durable receipt causes are classified independently from the current mint vocabulary, undecidable causes are refused before live reads, and the new standing/unreachable gauges are emitted unconditionally and exercised through real sweep paths, including a zero row and a no-write permanent-hold case. The independent writer/reader vocabulary assertion is non-vacuous. I found one minor annotation defect but no blocker or major issue.
